literal: On guihai day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Goryeo and Xia State.
idiomatic: On guihai day envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Goryeo and Xia State.

literal: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with the Empress Dowager's bequeathed goods as gifts to Song and Xia.
idiomatic: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with the Empress Dowager's bequeathed goods as gifts to Song and Xia.

literal: Summer, sixth month, on yiyou new moon, posthumous honorific for the late Empress Dowager: Empress Rende.
idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the sixth summer month the posthumous honorific for the late Empress Dowager was Empress Rende.

literal: On wuzi day Song and Goryeo and Xia State each dispatched envoys to offer condolences.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Song and Goryeo and Xia State each sent envoys to offer condolences.

literal: On jiawu day buried Empress Rende at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Empress Rende was buried at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On jihai day halted at Tuogulie.
idiomatic: On jihai day the court halted at Tuogulie.

literal: On renyin day dismissed Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin as regent of the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On renyin day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was dismissed as regent of the Central Capital.

literal: On dingwei day invested Empress Xiao; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Empress Xiao was invested; her father attendant langjun Bieliuli was enfeoffed Prince of Zhao; her uncle Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yuliye Prince of Liaoxi; her elder brother Han mobile palace deployment director and imperial son-in-law Xiamo Prince of Liucheng; Associate Administrator of Affairs Yang Zunxu was made administrator of Southern Court privy affairs; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Susa administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.

literal: On jiyou day Southern Court chancellor Zhao Hui retired.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Southern Court chancellor Zhao Hui retired.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day went to autumn mountains.
idiomatic: On wuchen day of the seventh autumn month the court went to autumn mountains.

literal: On guiyou day Prince of Liucheng Xiamo died.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Prince of Liucheng Xiamo died.

literal: Eighth month, on gengyin day hunted; encountering a fawn that had lost its mother, he pitied it and did not shoot.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the eighth month the court hunted; encountering a fawn that had lost its mother, the Emperor pitied it and did not shoot.

literal: Ninth month, on wuwu day, because Nanjing had locusts, next year's rent and tax were remitted.
idiomatic: On wuwu day of the ninth month, because Nanjing had locusts, next year's rent and tax were remitted.

literal: On jimao day halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On jimao day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu day summoned Central Capital regent Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin back as Northern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the tenth winter month Central Capital regent Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was summoned back as Northern Court privy commissioner.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day the Emperor wished to view the 《Diary of Actions and Repose》; revising annotator Lang did not carry it up, and Hutujin and others did not present it; each was beaten two hundred strokes and dismissed.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the eleventh month the Emperor wished to view the 《Diary of Actions and Repose》; revising annotator Lang did not carry it up, and Hutujin and others did not present it; each was beaten two hundred strokes and dismissed.

literal: Linya Xiao Yanshou was exiled to the Wuhui tribe.
idiomatic: Linya Xiao Yanshou was exiled to the Wuhui tribe.

literal: That month Nanjing had an earthquake; many commoners' houses were destroyed.
idiomatic: That month Nanjing had an earthquake; many commoners' houses were destroyed.

literal: Twelfth month, on jichou day Left yilibi Xiao Tabuye was made Nanjing supreme commander.
idiomatic: On jichou day of the twelfth month Left yilibi Xiao Tabuye was made Nanjing supreme commander.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on guichou day, went to the Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the third year, on guichou day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

literal: On yimao day reduced spring tribute of gold and silk in all routes and stopped yearly silver tribute to the imperial workshop.
idiomatic: On yimao day spring tribute of gold and silk in all routes was reduced and yearly silver tribute to the imperial workshop was stopped.

literal: Second month, on renwu new moon, Eastern Route supreme commander Xiao Hanjianu was honored imperial father and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.
idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the second month Eastern Route supreme commander Xiao Hanjianu was honored imperial father and enfeoffed Prince of Wu.

literal: On jiashen day, edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.
idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.

literal: On jichou day went to Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: On jichou day the court went to Yuer Marsh.

literal: On xinmao day the Central Capital had famine; the tour was stopped.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the Central Capital had famine; the tour was stopped.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on yiyou day boated on the Black Dragon River.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the fourth summer month the court boated on the Black Dragon River.

literal: Fifth month, on bingchen day Yutian and Anci had aphids that injured the crops.
idiomatic: On bingchen day of the fifth month Yutian and Anci had aphids that injured the crops.

literal: On guihai day there was a black spot in the sun.
idiomatic: On guihai day there was a black spot in the sun.

literal: On jisi day halted at Du Mountain.
idiomatic: On jisi day the court halted at Du Mountain.

literal: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.
idiomatic: On yihai day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin memorialized that Right Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala and others reported that associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Susa and eight others plotted to install the crown prince; the Emperor said it was groundless and did not punish; three including Susa were sent out to fill external posts; six including guard Sapo were each flogged more than a hundred strokes and exiled to the border.

literal: On bingzi day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northern Court chancellor and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northern Court chancellor and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace deployment affairs.

literal: On wuyin day, edict announced that those who reported plotting rebellion would be heavily rewarded with office.
idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict announced that those who reported plotting rebellion would be heavily rewarded with office.

literal: Sixth month, on jimao new moon, Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.
idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the sixth month Yelü Yixin ordered seal-and-tally langjun Xiao Eduwo to falsely accuse and say he had once joined Susa and the others in the plot, registering names to report.

literal: Immediately ordered Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.
idiomatic: Yixin and Yelü Zhongxi, Xiao Yuliye, Yelü Xiaojie, Yang Zunxu, Yange, Chaozhi, Xiao Shisan, and others were immediately ordered to investigate; the crown prince was beaten and imprisoned in the palace.

literal: On xinsi day killed three night-duty officials including Dirili.
idiomatic: On xinsi day three night-duty officials including Dirili were killed.

literal: On renwu day killed two including palace commissioner Tabuye.
idiomatic: On renwu day two including palace commissioner Tabuye were killed.

literal: On guimao day killed ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala; also dispatched envoys to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.
idiomatic: On guimao day ten including Shiping Army military commissioner Sala were killed; envoys were also dispatched to kill Supreme Capital regent Susa and the six exiled guards including Sapo.

literal: On yiyou day killed Yelü Tabuye and his younger brother Chenliu.
idiomatic: On yiyou day Yelü Tabuye and his younger brother Chenliu were killed.

literal: On bingxu day deposed the crown prince as commoner and imprisoned him at the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On bingxu day the crown prince was deposed as commoner and imprisoned at the Supreme Capital.

literal: On jichou day Uighur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On jichou day Uighur came with tribute.

literal: Killed Eastern Capital regent associate administrator Yelü Huilibu.
idiomatic: Eastern Capital regent associate administrator Yelü Huilibu was killed.

literal: On xinmao day killed Susa's sons and registered their households.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Susa's sons were killed and their households were registered.

literal: On wushen day dispatched envoys to investigate prisons in the Five Capitals and all routes.
idiomatic: On wushen day envoys were dispatched to investigate prisons in the Five Capitals and all routes.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month Defender of the Guard grand guardian Zhala was promoted Pacifying State grand general and hereditary in selection for Tielübu tribal military commissioner; Shiwei Zhala and Xiao Baoshennu and Molugu were all promoted Left Guard grand generals; seal-and-tally langjun Eduwo married the imperial daughter Princess of Zhao, was appointed imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Shiping Army; attendant langjun Yelü Tabuye and Xiao Tuguci were both promoted Defender of the Gate Commandant upper generals.

literal: On renzi day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.
idiomatic: On renzi day associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made Han mobile palace deployment director.

literal: On yichou day went to autumn mountains.
idiomatic: On yichou day the court went to autumn mountains.

literal: On dingchou day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Eighth month, on gengyin day Han mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hanjianu died.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the eighth month Han mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hanjianu died.

literal: On xinchou day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Ninth month, on guihai day Yutian presented auspicious grain.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the ninth month Yutian presented auspicious grain.

literal: On renshen day repaired Qian Mausoleum temple.
idiomatic: On renshen day Qian Mausoleum temple was repaired.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinchou day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: Eleventh month, Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin dispatched his private agents to assassinate the commoner Jun at the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Yixin dispatched his private agents to assassinate the commoner Jun at the Supreme Capital.

literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month, on wuwu day Northern Court chancellor Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Yange was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

literal: On bingyin day New Year's rites were performed in advance.
idiomatic: On bingyin day New Year's rites were performed in advance.

literal: That year Nanjing had a great harvest.
idiomatic: That year Nanjing had a great harvest.

literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on gengchen day, went to spring waters.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on gengchen day of the first spring month the court went to spring waters.

literal: On jiawu day relieved famine in the Eastern Capital.
idiomatic: On jiawu day famine in the Eastern Capital was relieved.

literal: Second month, on yichou day, halted at Saohuoye.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the second month the court halted at Saohuoye.

literal: On wuchen day Eastern Route supreme commander Yelü Wangjiu was made tiyin.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Eastern Route supreme commander Yelü Wangjiu was made tiyin.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai day Goryeo dispatched envoys begging grant of lands east of the Yalu River; not permitted.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent envoys begging grant of lands east of the Yalu River; permission was refused.

literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day, halted at Sanshui Plain.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the fifth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.

literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day Zubu tribal chiefs presented fine horses.
idiomatic: On jiayin day of the sixth month Zubu tribal chiefs presented fine horses.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiaxu day all routes memorialized feeding three hundred sixty thousand monks and nuns.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the seventh autumn month all routes memorialized feeding three hundred sixty thousand monks and nuns.

literal: Eighth month, on guimao day, edict ordered the relevant offices to decide delayed cases.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the eighth month an edict ordered the relevant offices to decide delayed cases.

literal: Ninth month, on yiwei day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On yiwei day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: On gengzi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengzi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on guimao day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made military commissioner of Baojing Army.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the tenth winter month Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made military commissioner of Baojing Army.

literal: Eleventh month, on dinghai day forbidden scholars and commoners to wear brocade and silk with sun, moon, mountain, and dragon designs.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the eleventh month scholars and commoners were forbidden to wear brocade and silk with sun, moon, mountain, and dragon designs.

literal: On jichou day Uighur dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jichou day Uighur sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhongxi was made military commissioner of Guangde Army.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhongxi was made military commissioner of Guangde Army.

literal: On xinmao day Jin Prefecture commoner Zhang Bao's four generations lived together; his sons were ordered attendants of the Third Class Court.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Jin Prefecture commoner Zhang Bao's four generations lived together; his sons were ordered attendants of the Third Class Court.

literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao day Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Li was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the twelfth month Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Li was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
